item: B1. ARG Energetica I 100 MW vs Vientos Bonaerenses (AES, Tres Picos)
proposal: dup('ARG', 'Energetica I wind farm', G, ('Vientos Bonaerenses wind farm', G), '同一座風場：Energética I 是 AES 在 Tornquist 縣 Tres Picos 的 Vientos Bonaerenses 風場（RenovAr 第 2 輪 79.8 MW＋MATER 二期 19.95 MW，合計 99.75 MW）；布宜諾斯艾利斯省環評增補書說「Energética I」風場要從 99.75 MW 擴建到 149.25 MW，第三期稱為「Vientos Bonaerenses - Fase III」；能源部電廠清單也把兩期列為 P.E. ENERGETICA I（79.8 MW）與其 fase 2（19.95 MW）', 'Same farm: Energética I is AES’s Vientos Bonaerenses farm at Tres Picos, Tornquist (79.8 MW from RenovAr round 2 plus a 19.95 MW MATER second phase, 99.75 MW in all); the Buenos Aires environmental addendum describes enlarging the “Energética I” farm from 99.75 MW to 149.25 MW with a third phase called “Vientos Bonaerenses - Fase III”, and the energy secretariat’s plant list shows the two phases as P.E. ENERGETICA I (79.8 MW) and its fase 2 (19.95 MW)', 'https://www.ambiente.gba.gob.ar/ParticipacionCiudadana/ADENDA%203.pdf'),
note_zh: Energética I（GEM，100 MW、無年份）就是 AES 的 Vientos Bonaerenses（GEM，99.8 MW，分期 2019 年 20 MW＋2020 年 79.8 MW）。環評增補書把「Energética I」擴建為第三期「Vientos Bonaerenses - Fase III」；能源部（CAMMESA 來源）電廠清單有 P.E. ENERGETICA I 79.8 MW 與 fase 2（MATER）19.95 MW，合計 99.75 MW，正是 Vientos Bonaerenses 的容量。
note_en: Energética I (GEM, 100 MW, no year) is AES’s Vientos Bonaerenses (GEM, 99.8 MW, phases 2019 20 MW + 2020 79.8 MW). The environmental addendum enlarges “Energética I” with a third phase called “Vientos Bonaerenses - Fase III”; the energy secretariat’s plant list (CAMMESA data) has P.E. ENERGETICA I 79.8 MW and its fase 2 (MATER) 19.95 MW, 99.75 MW together, which is Vientos Bonaerenses’ capacity.
why: Settled with the provincial environmental addendum (Adenda N°3 to the Energética I EIA) and the Secretaría de Energía plant list (datos.energia.gob.ar, updated 22 Sep 2026). GEM’s own Vientos Bonaerenses page lists “Energetica wind farm (Phase 1)” as another name. No existing rule touches either record. GEM’s Energetica phase 2 point (-38.3188, -62.2811) is GEM’s own placement; the plant list puts the MATER phase at Tornquist too.

item: B1b. ARG Tres Picos 100 MW (Nordex; AES, 2020) — third record of the same park
proposal: dup('ARG', 'Tres Picos wind farm', G, ('Vientos Bonaerenses wind farm', G), '同一座風場：GEM 的 Tres Picos（100 MW，2020，AES／Nordex）另名「Bonaerenses 1」，座標與 Vientos Bonaerenses 相同；AES 的 Vientos Bonaerenses 位於 Tornquist 縣 Tres Picos，裝置容量 99.75 MW', 'Same farm: GEM’s Tres Picos (100 MW, 2020, AES / Nordex) is also called “Bonaerenses 1” and sits on Vientos Bonaerenses’ point; AES’s Vientos Bonaerenses lies at Tres Picos, Tornquist, with 99.75 MW installed', 'https://econojournal.com.ar/?p=48367'),
note_zh: Tres Picos（GEM）是同一座 Vientos Bonaerenses 的第三筆紀錄：GEM 頁面另名「Bonaerenses 1」，座標（-38.3601, -62.2257）與 Vientos Bonaerenses（-38.3598, -62.2257）相同，容量 100 MW 對 99.75 MW。
note_en: Tres Picos (GEM) is a third record of the same Vientos Bonaerenses: its GEM page gives “Bonaerenses 1” as another name and its point (-38.3601, -62.2257) is Vientos Bonaerenses’ (-38.3598, -62.2257); 100 MW against 99.75 MW.
why: Found while settling B1: the three records (Energetica I, Tres Picos, Vientos Bonaerenses) lie within 3 km and add to ~300 MW for one 99.75 MW park. The announced phases 3–4 record (Vientos Bonaerenses wind farm · 3, 4) is a separate expansion and is left alone.

item: A2. ARG Santa Teresita 50 MW — built since Oct 2022?
proposal: fix('ARG', 'Santa Teresita wind farm', G, '尚未建成：2019 年取得環評許可與電力批發市場發電業者資格（Vientos Punta Alta S.A.），2022 年 10 月電力管理局（ENRE）的併網公告仍說它「將有」50.4 MW、接到「未來的」Vientos Fray Güen 變電所；能源部 2026 年 9 月更新的電廠清單（CAMMESA 資料）在 General Alvarado 縣只有 Miramar 一座風場，沒有 Santa Teresita', 'Not built yet: it obtained its environmental permit and wholesale-market generator status (Vientos Punta Alta S.A.) in 2019, and ENRE’s grid-access notice of October 2022 still says it “will have” 50.4 MW connected to the “future” Vientos Fray Güen substation; the energy secretariat’s plant list (CAMMESA data, updated September 2026) has only the Miramar wind farm in General Alvarado and no Santa Teresita', 'https://www.boletinoficial.gob.ar/detalleAviso/primera/273857/20221018', st=2, note=True),
note_zh: GEM 的「運轉中」沒有出處支持：2022 年 10 月的官方公告仍是未來式；能源部電廠清單（2026-09-22 更新，CAMMESA 機組代碼）裡 General Alvarado 縣唯一的風場是 Miramar（98.6 MW），也沒有 Vientos Punta Alta 的機組。業主是 Vientos Punta Alta S.A.（GEM 寫 Eoliasur）。
note_en: GEM’s “operating” has no support: the October 2022 official notice is still in the future tense, and in the energy secretariat’s plant list (updated 22 Sep 2026, CAMMESA unit codes) the only wind plant in General Alvarado is Miramar (98.6 MW), with no Vientos Punta Alta unit. The company is Vientos Punta Alta S.A. (GEM says Eoliasur).
why: Evidence of non-construction is an absence from the national plant list (a list of every CAMMESA-registered plant, recent MATER parks included even without a capacity figure) plus the 2022 future-tense notice; no news of construction or commissioning found. st=2 (pre-construction) because the environmental permit and MEM agent status exist; if the main session prefers, st=3. The Eoliasur portfolio page GEM cites is only on web.archive.org (blocked here).

item: B2. ISR Afcon vs WRI “Mount Gilboa” (21 MW, 2017)
proposal: dup('ISR', 'Mount Gilboa', P, ('Afcon wind farm', G), '同一座風場：WRI 的 Mount Gilboa（21 MW，2017）就是 Afcon 在 Ma’ale Gilboa 的風場（Afcon 在 Gilboa 與 Ramat Sirin 兩處共 25 部、約 22 MW，其中 14 部在 Ma’ale Gilboa）；GEM 把 Afcon 風場的 Ma’ale Gilboa 期標在 32.4687 N、35.4268 E，距 WRI 的點不到 0.5 公里，吉爾博亞山沒有其他風場', 'Same farm: WRI’s Mount Gilboa (21 MW, 2017) is Afcon’s farm at Ma’ale Gilboa (Afcon’s Gilboa and Ramat Sirin sites have 25 turbines and about 22 MW, 14 of them at Ma’ale Gilboa); GEM places the Ma’ale Gilboa phase of the Afcon farm at 32.4687 N, 35.4268 E, under 0.5 km from WRI’s point, and there is no other wind farm on Mount Gilboa', 'https://www.gem.wiki/Afcon_wind_farm'),
note_zh: WRI GPPD 有兩筆 Afcon：「Sirin Afcon」（21 MW，2017，32.647 N 35.523 E）建置時已併掉，「Mount Gilboa」（21 MW，2017，32.466 N 35.426 E，業主誤植為以色列電力公司）留了下來。GEM Afcon 風場的兩期：Ma’ale Gilboa 12 MW（32.4687, 35.4268）、Sirin 10 MW（32.6463…）。
note_en: WRI GPPD has two Afcon rows: “Sirin Afcon” (21 MW, 2017, 32.647 N 35.523 E), already merged by the build, and “Mount Gilboa” (21 MW, 2017, 32.466 N 35.426 E, owner wrongly given as Israel Electric Corporation), which survived. GEM’s Afcon farm has two phases: Ma’ale Gilboa 12 MW (32.4687, 35.4268) and Sirin 10 MW (32.6463…).
why: WRI repeats the whole complex’s ~21 MW on each site row; the GEM record (22 MW, year 2016 from the existing fix) already covers both sites. Keep the existing Afcon fix (year 2016).

item: A3. POL Tyszowce 34 MW (Kresy I 30 MW?)
proposal: fix('POL', 'Tyszowce wind farm', G, '補上商轉年 2016 並更正容量：氣候環境部 2026 年答覆國會質詢（資料來自能源管理局 URE）列出 Tyszowce 鎮 30 MW 的風電裝置、2016-02-17 首次登記發電；OpenStreetMap 的 Tyszowce 風場由 EDP Renewables Polska 營運、30 MW；當地報紙說該場 15 部風機，屬 EDP Renewables 的 Elektrownia Wiatrowa Kresy I 公司', 'Commissioning year 2016 added and capacity corrected: the climate ministry’s 2026 answer to a parliamentary question (data from the energy regulator URE) lists a 30 MW wind installation in Tyszowce, first registered as generating on 17 Feb 2016; OpenStreetMap’s Tyszowce wind farm is operated by EDP Renewables Polska, 30 MW; the local paper says it has 15 turbines and belongs to EDP Renewables’ company Elektrownia Wiatrowa Kresy I', 'https://api.sejm.gov.pl/sejm/term10/interpellations/attachment/ATTDR9JYS/i12647-o1.pdf', year=2016, mw=30, owner='EDP Renewables Polska'),
note_zh: 34 MW 來自 The Wind Power（另名 Kresy 1），與 URE（30 MW）、OSM（30 MW，15 部 2 MW）、波蘭維基（15 部、30 MW）不符。年份：URE「啟用日期」2016-02-17（首次登記為受特許的發電設施）；OSM 的 start_date 寫 2015，當地報紙 2019 年 1 月說「已轉了三年」，與 2016 一致。
note_en: The 34 MW comes from The Wind Power (other name Kresy 1) and disagrees with URE (30 MW), OSM (30 MW, 15 × 2 MW) and Polish Wikipedia (15 turbines, 30 MW). Year: URE “activation date” 17 Feb 2016 (first registration as a licensed generating installation); OSM’s start_date says 2015, and the local paper said in January 2019 that the turbines had been turning “for three years”, which fits 2016.
why: New source: the Ministry of Climate and Environment’s answer of 11 Feb 2026 to interpellation K10INT12647, a URE table of every wind installation above 10 MW with gmina, capacity and first-registration date (225 rows, 8.4 GW). The Tyszowce row is the only one in the gmina; EDPR’s neighbouring Tomaszów Lubelski farm (46.5 MW) has the same date.

item: A4. POL Reńska Wieś 45 MW — built or not?
proposal: drop('POL', 'Reńska Wieś wind farm', G, '查無建成紀錄：能源管理局（URE）2026 年列出全部 10 MW 以上風電裝置的表在 Kędzierzyn-Koźle 縣沒有任何一筆；2026 年 1 月奧波萊環保局的公告顯示「Reńska Wieś 風場」只是 6 部風機的申請案，開發商已要求撤案；OpenStreetMap 在該村 6 公里內沒有風機', 'No evidence it was built: the energy regulator’s (URE) 2026 table of every wind installation above 10 MW has none in Kędzierzyn-Koźle county; the Opole environment directorate’s notice of January 2026 shows “Farma wiatrowa Reńska Wieś” as a six-turbine application that the developer has asked to discontinue; OpenStreetMap has no wind turbine within 6 km of the village', 'https://www.gov.pl/attachment/e9087ed7-c3c3-4121-a9a2-6cc10e7f984e'),
note_zh: GEM 的「運轉中」只出自 2016 年《Wind Energy Poland》報告（案場清單）與沒有日期的 The Wind Power（15 部、Yard Energy 開發），座標是村中心的概略點。URE 表（225 筆、8.4 GW）的奧波萊省各列都不在 Kędzierzyn-Koźle 縣；OSM（Overpass，2026-10-09）在 50.313 N、18.127 E 周圍 6 公里內沒有任何風機或風場。
note_en: GEM’s “operating” rests only on the 2016 “Wind Energy Poland” report (a project list) and an undated The Wind Power page (15 turbines, developer Yard Energy); the point is an approximate spot at the village centre. None of the URE table’s Opole rows (225 rows, 8.4 GW in all) is in Kędzierzyn-Koźle county; OSM (Overpass, 9 Oct 2026) has no turbine or wind plant within 6 km of 50.313 N, 18.127 E.
why: Absence-based: the URE table covers single installations above 10 MW (8.4 GW of Poland’s ~11 GW), so a farm split into ≤10 MW installations would not show; the OSM check (no turbines at all near the village) covers that gap. The 2026 RDOŚ notice is positive evidence that the only “Farma wiatrowa Reńska Wieś” on record is an unbuilt proposal. If the main session wants a stricter standard, keep it as a lead.

item: A5. POL Klukowo/Samborsko 105 MW (Engie) — built or not?
proposal: (ready if accepted) drop('POL', 'Klukowo/Samborsko wind farm', G, '查無建成紀錄：GDF Suez（Engie）2012 年取得的 Klukowo（23 部 3 MW）與 Samborsko（18 部 2 MW）共 105 MW 案沒有建成：Engie 在波蘭只有 Jarogniew-Mołtowo、Wartkowo、Pągów 與 Dąbrowice 四處風場；能源管理局 2026 年 10 MW 以上風電裝置表在 Złotów 縣只有 2024–2025 年的 Tarnówka、Okonek、Jastrowie 三筆（後兩者是 Exus 的新風場）', 'No evidence it was built: the 105 MW Klukowo (23 × 3 MW) and Samborsko (18 × 2 MW) project GDF Suez (Engie) took over in 2012 was not built: Engie’s Polish wind farms are Jarogniew-Mołtowo, Wartkowo, Pągów and Dąbrowice; the energy regulator’s 2026 table of wind installations above 10 MW has only Tarnówka, Okonek and Jastrowie (2024–2025; the last two are Exus’s new farms) in Złotów county', 'https://www.rynekinfrastruktury.pl/wiadomosci/intermodal-i-logistyka/wielkopolska-gdf-suez-buduje-farme-wiatrowa-w-klukowie-24502.html'),
note_zh: 2012 年 11 月 GDF Suez 為 Klukowo 招標地質調查，105 MW（Klukowo 23×3 MW、Samborsko 18×2 MW）。之後沒有建成消息；Engie 公司簡介列四處風場、合計 138 MW，沒有 Klukowo。URE 表在 Złotów 縣只有 Tarnówka 14.025 MW（2024）、Okonek 22.87 MW（2025）、Jastrowie 30.74 MW（2025）。OSM：Samborsko 村周圍約 4.5 公里內沒有風機；Klukowo 村旁只有 6 部（就是本站的 Eurowind Złotów 12 MW）。
note_en: In November 2012 GDF Suez tendered geotechnical work for Klukowo, 105 MW (Klukowo 23 × 3 MW, Samborsko 18 × 2 MW). No later construction news; Engie’s company profile lists four farm sites, 138 MW, without Klukowo. The URE table has only Tarnówka 14.025 MW (2024), Okonek 22.87 MW (2025) and Jastrowie 30.74 MW (2025) in Złotów county. OSM: no turbine within about 4.5 km of Samborsko village; only six turbines next to Klukowo village (the site’s Eurowind Złotów, 12 MW).
why: Left as a lead because the URE table also lacks Eurowind’s 12 MW Złotów farm (2015), so the table may miss farms registered as smaller installations, and the Engie profile is undated. Still missing: a dated statement that the project was abandoned or sold (gmina Złotów / Jastrowie planning documents, Engie annual report). GEM’s “operating” comes from the 2016 “Wind Energy Poland” project report; thewindpower lists Samborsko “operational 36 MW” with no date or owner.

item: A6. NLD remaining no-year farms: dismantled or still running?
farm: (21 Dutch operating farms without a year: Mammoettocht, Neeltje Jans – Vluchtheuvel, De Kleine Trap, Haagen, Bosruitertocht, Amsterdam-Westpoort, Van Pallandtpolder, Midlum, Ritthem, Wagendorp, Ooievaarsweg, Roompotsluis, Netterden-Azewijn, Noordertocht, Windstroom, Futenweg, Dodaarsweg, Laaksche Vaart, St. Antoinedijk, Van Gogh, Windpark Hoofdplaatpolder BV)
proposal: (no rule yet) Noordertocht: candidate st=4 once the removal year (2024 or 2025) is sourced. All others: keep st=0.
note_zh: 新出處：RIVM（國家公衛環境研究院）公開的全國風機圖層有 2024-01-01 與 2026-01-01 兩個快照（WFS，公有領域）。比對每筆紀錄 1.5 公里內的風機：只有 Noordertocht（Vattenfall，6 部 1.75 MW，Lelystad／Dronten）的舊風機在 2024 年還在、2026 年已全數消失（同一範圍 15 → 0 部），應是 Windplan Groen 汰換時拆除，年份 2024 或 2025 待查。Zeewolde 一帶的 Dodaarsweg、Ooievaarsweg、Futenweg、De Kleine Trap、Bosruitertocht 等舊風機 2026-01-01 仍在；RVO《2025 陸域風電監測》也說 Windpark Zeewolde 的 153.3 MW 舊機仍「待 2026 年拆除」，所以現在不能改成除役。Ritthem 與 Roompotsluis 的點附近沒有風機（已知錯置在別省，見 TODO）。
note_en: New source: RIVM’s national wind-turbine layer has snapshots for 1 Jan 2024 and 1 Jan 2026 (WFS, public domain). Comparing turbines within 1.5 km of each record: only Noordertocht (Vattenfall, six 1.75 MW, Lelystad/Dronten) had its old turbines standing in 2024 and none in 2026 (15 → 0 in the same box), presumably removed for Windplan Groen; the year (2024 or 2025) still needs a source. The old Zeewolde-area turbines (Dodaarsweg, Ooievaarsweg, Futenweg, De Kleine Trap, Bosruitertocht, …) still stood on 1 Jan 2026, and RVO’s Monitor Wind op Land 2025 still lists Windpark Zeewolde’s 153.3 MW of old turbines as “to be removed in 2026”, so none can be marked retired yet. The Ritthem and Roompotsluis points have no turbines nearby (known misplacements, see TODO).
why: RIVM layers alo:rivm_20240101_Windturbines_vermogen and alo:rivm_20260101_windturbines_vermogen (data.rivm.nl/geo/alo/wfs) carry kW, rotor and hub height but no commissioning date and no park name for NL rows, so they cannot supply years. The RVO 2025 monitor table names projects, not the old parks being removed. Windplan Groen’s 2024 overview PDF on rvo.nl returns 404. Next: Vattenfall or Windplan Groen news on removing the Noordertocht line; re-run the RIVM comparison when the 2027 snapshot appears (Zeewolde removals due by end-2026).

note_zh: Windtech 2005 年 10 月 21 日：Gamesa Energía 啟用位於 Cocullo（L’Aquila）的 Pietrafitta 風場，37 部 850 kW。GlobalData：Pietrafitta 31.45 MW，Acciona Energia 開發（實為收購）、現屬 Acciona Eolica Cesa Italia，2004 年 12 月商轉。保留 Pietrafitta 的 2005（Windtech 的啟用日期）。
note_en: Windtech, 21 Oct 2005: Gamesa Energía opened the Pietrafitta wind farm in Cocullo (L’Aquila), 37 turbines of 850 kW. why: Both records are GEM; the keep (Pietrafitta) already has the year 2005 but an owner that is the turbine maker, so the dup will not move Cocullo’s owner (keep has one) — hence the separate owner fix. GlobalData’s Dec 2004 vs Windtech’s Oct 2005 opening: left at 2005.

dup('FRA', 'Entre Seine Et Aube wind farm', G, ('La Prévoterie wind farm', G), '同一座風場：Entre Seine Et Aube 的兩期（2010 年 37 MW、營運者 SNC MSE La Prévoterie，與 2013 年 12 MW）就是 MSE La Prévoterie 的 24 部 Senvion MM92（每部 2.05 MW，DREAL 2023 檢查報告），與 La Prévoterie 紀錄的一期重複', 'Same farm: Entre Seine Et Aube’s two phases (37 MW in 2010, operator SNC MSE La Prévoterie, and 12 MW in 2013) are MSE La Prévoterie’s 24 Senvion MM92 of 2.05 MW each (DREAL inspection 2023), the same as the first phase of the La Prévoterie record', 'https://www.georisques.gouv.fr/webappReport/ws/installations/inspection/2i8nYuDSMRS98v4Y99FawaYAgaB3dgkK'),
    fix('FRA', 'La Prévoterie wind farm', G, '補上一期年份與 Rhèges 期：MSE La Prévoterie 原有 24 部 Senvion MM92（2.05 MW），其中 18 部 36.9 MW 於 2010 年併網、Rhèges 的 6 部 12.3 MW 登錄日期 2014-01-01；另有 2021 年 Eolis Les Champs 擴建 12 MW，合計 61.2 MW', 'First-phase year and the Rhèges phase added: MSE La Prévoterie originally has 24 Senvion MM92 (2.05 MW), 18 of them (36.9 MW) connected in 2010 and the six at Rhèges (12.3 MW) registered on 1 Jan 2014; with the 12 MW Eolis Les Champs extension of 2021 the total is 61.2 MW', 'https://www.georisques.gouv.fr/webappReport/ws/installations/inspection/2i8nYuDSMRS98v4Y99FawaYAgaB3dgkK', year=2010, mw=61.2, ph=[[2010, 36.9], [2014, 12.3], [2021, 12]]),
note_zh: 依上一輪（DD A9b）的查證定案：保留營運者與 DREAL 用的名稱 La Prévoterie。GEM 的 La Prévoterie 一期 36.9 MW 沒有年份，建置時整筆被算成 2021 年；Entre Seine Et Aube 的一期（2010，37 MW，營運者 SNC MSE La Prévoterie）就是它。Rhèges 期 GEM 寫 2013、登錄寫 2014-01-01（可能是代用日期），採登錄。
note_en: Settles round 21’s lead (DD A9b): keep La Prévoterie, the operator’s and DREAL’s name. GEM’s La Prévoterie phase 1 (36.9 MW) has no year, so the build dated the whole record 2021; Entre Seine Et Aube’s phase 1 (2010, 37 MW, operator SNC MSE La Prévoterie) is that phase. GEM dates the Rhèges phase 2013 and the register 1 Jan 2014 (possibly a placeholder); the register is used.
why: Existing rules (drops of Droupt-Sainte-Marie and Droupt-Saint-Basle) already rely on these records covering the 2010 delivery points, and neither record is removed by an existing rule. Option B (keep Entre Seine Et Aube and cut La Prévoterie to its 12 MW 2021 extension) would also work; option A chosen because the 2021 extension belongs to La Prévoterie in GEM and DREAL.

item: C1. FRA Tournevents du COS — year 2017 (WKN, DREAL) or 2019 (register)
farm: Les Tournevents du COS wind farm
proposal: EDIT the existing rule (farm_cleanup.py line ~1994) to: fix('FRA', 'Les Tournevents du COS wind farm', G, '補上商轉年 2017：DREAL 2026 年檢查報告說 Tournevents du Cos 風場（Cugny、Ollezy、Sommette-Eaucourt 的 6 部風機）2017-11-10 投入運轉，業者出示 2017 年底的試運轉報告；國家發電設施登錄（ODRÉ）的 Tournevents du COS 1（9.6 MW）2017-10-26 併網，COS 2（12 MW）登錄 2019-02-01，晚於全場運轉', 'Commissioning year 2017 added: the DREAL inspection report of 2026 says the Tournevents du Cos farm (six turbines in Cugny, Ollezy and Sommette-Eaucourt) was commissioned on 10 Nov 2017, and the operator showed its commissioning reports of late 2017; the national register (ODRÉ) has Tournevents du COS 1 (9.6 MW) connected on 26 Oct 2017 and COS 2 (12 MW) registered on 1 Feb 2019, after the whole farm was running', 'https://www.georisques.gouv.fr/webappReport/ws/installations/inspection/2xzzzv7Eq1OiLrjvoR5Ks0ZyJHCnSz7P', year=2017),  # drop the ph=[[2017, 9.6], [2019, 12]] argument
note_zh: DREAL（2026-07-02 檢查）：Tournevents du Cos 風場 6 部、2015-12-28 核准、2017-11-10 投入運轉，2018 年中做過「運轉後」噪音量測。6 部 × 3.6 MW＝21.6 MW，與登錄兩點合計相同；COS 2 的 2019-02-01 不是首次併網（2018 年 6–7 月已是運轉後量測）。
note_en: DREAL (inspection of 2 July 2026): the Tournevents du Cos farm has six turbines, authorised on 28 Dec 2015 and commissioned on 10 Nov 2017, with an acoustic check “after commissioning” in June–July 2018. Six × 3.6 MW = 21.6 MW, the two register points together; COS 2’s 1 Feb 2019 is not its first connection (the 2018 check was already after commissioning).
why: The current rule follows the register (year=2019, phases 2017/2019). DREAL states one commissioning date for the whole six-turbine farm, so the 2019 phase is a register artefact. Note: the existing Sommette-Eaucourt dup text says “nine Nordex N117” (from John Laing); DREAL says six turbines (the AIOT is labelled “parc eolien 9 mâts”), which the main session may want to reword.

item: C3. TUN Bizerte Métline / Kchabta — extension year
farm: Bizerte Métline wind farm; Bizerte Kchabta wind farm
proposal: (no rule yet) candidates: year=2013 (GlobalData, whole project) or year=2012 (first stage)
note_zh: GlobalData：Metline 95.04 MW（一期 46 部＋二期 26 部 AE-61 1.32 MW）、Kchabta 93.72 MW（45＋26 部），兩場都寫「分期開發，完工後 2013 年商轉」。但本站 IRENA 數列 2013 年全國 200 MW、2014 年 233 MW、2015 年 240 MW，扣掉 Sidi Daoud 54 MW，2013 年底比薩大風場只有約 146 MW，表示擴建可能到 2014–2015 年才完成；2019 年報導又說 143 部「2012 年設置」。三種說法互相矛盾。
note_en: GlobalData: Metline 95.04 MW (phase 1 46 + phase 2 26 AE-61 of 1.32 MW) and Kchabta 93.72 MW (45 + 26), both “developed in multiple phases … commissioned in 2013”. But the site’s IRENA series has 200 MW nationally in 2013, 233 MW in 2014 and 240 MW in 2015; less Sidi Daoud’s 54 MW, Bizerte had only about 146 MW at the end of 2013, so the extension may have finished in 2014–2015, while a 2019 article says all 143 turbines were “installed in 2012”. The three disagree.
why: No STEG annual report or extension commissioning notice found this round either. Next: STEG annual reports 2013–2015 (steg.com.tn rapport annuel), ANME publications.
